title: Hold Extensions on a Homesite Reservation
content:
An extension pushes out the hold of a Homesite Reservation, and the extended hold term is fixed: the number of calendar days from the reservation date to the hold expiry date written with the extension.

## Conditions on the reservation record

> The extended hold term is fixed only after the reservation has left the pending deposit status and stands in held status.

> Where the extension fee charged for an extension is above zero, the extension is not written until an extension fee payment for it stands on the reservation ledger.

Restated against the record: a reservation whose status still reads pending deposit has no extended hold term, and where the extension fee charged is above zero, the reservation ledger must already show an extension fee payment for that extension when the extension is written.

## Business effect

Writing the extension rewrites the reservation's hold expiry date as the reservation date plus the extended hold term and records the new count of extensions used. Nothing is posted to the reservation ledger by the extension itself.

## Invocation: `extend_homesite_hold_1f65db7b`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool writes a hold extension on a Homesite Reservation, pushing its hold expiry date out.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `extend_homesite_hold_1f65db7b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | the reference number of the Homesite Reservation being extended, as returned by the Homesite Reservation lookup for the buyer | identifier |
| `reserved_date` | the reservation date shown on that same reservation record; the day the extended hold term is counted from, copied unchanged from the record | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `total_hold_days` | the extended hold term as a whole number of calendar days from the reservation date to the last day of the extended hold; the hold expiry date written is the reservation date plus this many days | integer of at least 1, never a fraction |
| `extensions_used` | the number of extensions written on the reservation once this extension is counted: the count on the record before this extension plus one | integer of 0 or more |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `reservation_id` (the reservation extended), `hold_expiry_date` (the new hold expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `extensions_used` (the extension count now on the reservation). A receipt with the new `hold_expiry_date` means the extension was recorded.

## Input and return illustration (hypothetical)

A reservation dated 2026-05-04 whose record shows 0 extensions used, written with `total_hold_days` 19 and `extensions_used` 1, returns `hold_expiry_date` 2026-05-23 and `extensions_used` 1.
